goals.title: Earn from 3 subnets simultaneously
goals.specific: Grow from a single-subnet position to three income sources so one deregistration or emission cut cannot zero the operation.
goals.achievable: Reuse existing hardware where possible; add CPU-mined subnets from the CPU Guide to avoid new GPU spend.
goals.relevant: Concentration is the top killer seen in the payout audits — top-heavy reward curves can cut a miner to zero within weeks.

goals.title: Run a profitable SN53 GPU miner
goals.specific: Deploy the sglang miner stack (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8, 4×24 GB GPU), register a UID on subnet 53 and keep TOPLOC proofs passing so the validator assigns incentive.
goals.achievable: Rent 4× RTX 4090 (or own 141 GB+ VRAM). Burn registration ≈ 0.0005 TAO. Miner connects outbound to wss://api.engy.ai/gw — no open ports needed.
goals.relevant: SN53 pays miners in alpha (~0.033 TAO/α moving price). Building the stack before registering survives the ~1-block immunity window.

goals.title: Onboard as an SN51 GPU host
goals.specific: List idle GPU capacity on lium.io via the Host & Earn path, pass provider checks and serve the first renter job.
goals.achievable: One 24 GB GPU, stable connection, docker installed. Follow the Setup Guide section 05e step by step.
goals.relevant: Host income is the lowest-risk lane: no incentive race, rent paid per hour of uptime.

goals.title: Register my first subnet UID
goals.specific: Choose one subnet from Miner Fit / Opportunities, confirm its registration window and burn cost, then register the hotkey and hold the UID past immunity.
goals.achievable: Wallet funded with registration burn + small stake. No code required for stake-mined subnets; recipe guides live in Runbook.
goals.relevant: Holding a UID is the entry ticket to every mining strategy — nothing earns before this.
